epigraph.p: The sea keeps what it is given.

section.p: Every ship that passed the rock was a story she would never hear the end of. She liked the hour before dawn best, when the light was still working and the world was not. In the evenings she read by the stove, a blanket over her knees and the cat asleep against her ankle. She learned the voices of the weather the way other people learn the voices of their neighbours.
